card.title: ARDENNES
card.text: The Germans used the hilly Ardennes to launch several offensives during the war.
card.flavorText: The Ardennes, also known as the Forest of Ardennes or the Ardennes Forest, is a region of rough terrain, hills and extensive forest. Ardennes is a region in southeast Belgium and extends into Luxembourg, Germany and France, and its strategic position has made it a European battleground for centuries. The Germans have used the region to stage three major battles in the 20th century, in WWI it was the Battle of the Ardennes (1914), and twice during WWII, the Battle of France (1940) and the Battle of the Bulge (1944–1945).
